title: Recovered memory of a virtual tour of Egypt
summary: Chris Bledsoe tells of Recovered memory of a virtual tour of Egypt, about 2007 at Egypt (no place named), and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

plain: Chris Bledsoe is a man who says UFOs are drawn to him. He told podcast host Jesse Michels that after an encounter in 2007, he remembered being taken on what felt like a virtual tour of Egypt, and the first thing he saw was the pyramids, then the Sphinx and a temple of Hathor, an ancient Egyptian goddess. He wondered why they showed him Egypt.
